reason: The GL Code combobox has autocomplete="garbage" next to data-1p-ignore, data-lpignore and data-bwignore, a deliberate autofill opt-out. It picks a chart-of-accounts code for the transaction, not information about the user, and the tree still exposes combobox "GL Code" with its states.
criterionAnalysis: 1.3.5 Identify Input Purpose applies only to fields that collect information about the user and serve a purpose in the WCAG input-purpose list (name, email, address, card number and so on). The GL Code field assigns a general-ledger code to a bank transaction, so it has no listed purpose and 1.3.5 cannot fail. 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value is met: the ax probe shows combobox "GL Code" [expanded=false, haspopup=listbox]. No other A or AA criterion covers an autocomplete token on this field.

reason: The Check images label is a dt inside a plain div in the drawer section, with no dl ancestor, so the tree exposes a bare term (1.3.1). The two check images keep their own alt text (front of the check, back of the check), so the impact is minor and it stays low.
